title: Changes opens over a page, and a new page takes the canvas back
reason: The loaded shared runner shows the Project region empty although the commit is there, on both tries, while a Windows VM and the Mac pass this file every run at the same commit. It wobbled once in survey 18, where it was listed at its old line.

title: Cmd+R serves the UI as it is now; Cmd+Shift+R restarts the host in place, and a working agent continues afterwards
reason: The agent never starts a tool, so the turn is not still running across the restart.

title: a host stopped from outside, like the tray's Restart, keeps the queued messages and sends them once it is back
reason: The restart/queue carry-over chain is fragile on Windows: one try queued nothing although its tool was running, the other carried the message across the restart but never got a reply. Which of this file's two real-model tests dies swaps between machines and runs, so the fragment is the loosest text both tries share.

title: ! runs a command in the workspace folder, and its output goes to the agent with the next message unless dropped
failure: Locator: locator('.user-command').filter({ hasText: 'sleep 30; echo never' }).last().locator('.shell-exit') Expected: "stopped"
reason: Stop misses Git Bash children that carry a stale parent pid, so the stopped command's row never records the stop. It fails every time on a Windows VM, and on the runner it failed in survey 10 and went over in survey 11.
